verdict.rationale: The professional portal links to its own tutorials section, a practical guide on the e-invoicing reform, and FAQ-style help pages. That shows first-party explanatory guidance beyond statute text and form numbers, but the evidence is only navigation-level link text with no content showing plain-language, step-by-step walkthroughs. Missing for 10: evidence of the actual step-by-step content, coverage of founder tasks such as company creation and VAT registration, independent or hands-on confirmation that a non-lawyer can follow it.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: Ce guide pratique précise les conditions de démarrage de la réforme effective depuis le 1er septembre.
